notes: The criterion is genuine-action and choice-dependent; it is not an unqualified outer-action assertion.

statement: The nonlinear additive-polynomial direction is outside the actual profinite signed-action image on the integral abelian stages.
notes: Ambient group-scheme kernel directions and retained profinite source images are different objects.

statement: The rank-five naive Hall class-two group scheme cannot carry the verified modular rho action after reduction modulo2.
notes: rho sends e2 to e1+e4; their squares are incompatible, for every central lift.

statement: The same rational class-two group and designated abelian quotient admit integral models with opposite nonlinear-lift behaviour at2.
notes: The laws with central terms ab-prime and 2ab-prime are rationally isomorphic; their characteristic-two fibres differ.
